- Handle base cases n in [0,1,2,3] by returning [0,0,2,0] accordingly; for n < 0 raise ValueError.
- Use an iterative dynamic programming approach with O(1) space: maintain a rolling window of the last four values (v3, v2, v1, v0) initialized to [0,0,2,0].
- For i from 4 to n, compute next = v0+v1+v2+v3, shift window (drop oldest, append next); return current when loop ends.
